#!/bin/bash
cd /home/dylan/asymetric-dual-encoders
export PATH="/home/dylan/asymetric-dual-encoders/.venv-gen/bin:$PATH"  # inductor shells out to ninja
export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0   # flashinfer JITs sampling kernels; CUDA 12.6 nvcc rejects
                                      # this box's gcc 15 (max 13) and only gcc-15 is installed.
                                      # Falls back to torch sampling -- same semantics.
export VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1   # WSL2 kernel 6.6.87 clears vLLM's own >=4.19.121 gate;
                                       # pinning verified working on this driver (torch pin_memory + H2D)
exec .venv-gen/bin/vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B-AWQ \
  --revision 4da05a8edb55c6046cce958586c33b61da07bb79 \
  --max-model-len 4096 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 \
  --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --port 8001 --host 127.0.0.1
shape: 8 seeds x 8 forms (7 generated + factoid), n=5, all in flight
note: Gate is >=90% contract and >=700 aggregate output tok/s. Both met. The floor is met even on the cold run. --enforce-eager (needed while KV memory was being sized) cost 1.69x: 441 tok/s eager vs 745 cold / ~1117 warm with CUDA graphs. Serving fixes this box needed: VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1 (WSL disables pinning, and vLLM's buffer path then fails on UVA), VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 (flashinfer JITs kernels and CUDA 12.6 nvcc rejects this box's gcc 15), gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 (only 8.86 of 10 GiB is free), port 8001.
